## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`) and follows Conventional Commits
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` pass
- [ ] API changed → `openapi.json` snapshot reviewed and updated
- [ ] Admin templates or CSS changed → `assets/static/admin.css` rebuilt
- [ ] New strings added to both `locales/en.yml` and `locales/ru.yml`
